svg.text: Collagen PLUS
Questions & Answers
NAFU LIFE product guidance
Q1. When can I start taking collagen?
NAFU LIFE suggests starting at age 20. It says collagen gradually
declines from around ages 20–25.
Q2. How many sachets should I take each day?
One sachet daily; the brand suggests two for enhanced use.
Q3. When is the best time to drink it?
The brand recommends taking it on an empty stomach.
Q4. Can I take it while pregnant or breastfeeding?
Consult your obstetrician or healthcare professional first.
Q5. Is it suitable for vegetarians?
No. Its collagen is fish-derived.
Q6. Is it suitable for people with seafood allergies?
No. It contains marine-derived ingredients.
Q7. Does it taste fishy?
The brand describes it as sweet and tart, without a fishy taste.
Q8. Why is the drink pink?
The pink color comes from the added astaxanthin.
Translated from the NAFU LIFE reference graphic. Follow the current product label.
